generation_parents.algorithm: For each candidate I compute a savings term from inserting it now versus serving it later from the depot, then combine a normalized nearest-neighbor distance, remaining-capacity slack penalty, and a demand-aware depot-return cost into a single additive priority that favors customers whose immediate service saves the most detour while keeping the route balanced.
